title: Summary — Skill Check
description: Summarize sections and whole passages without adding or narrowing the author’s meaning.
subject: rla
author: Chee Skool
reviewNotes: Unseen independent check; no hints, retries, or guided scaffolding.

questions.prompt: Which sentence best summarizes the first paragraph?

options.text: Researchers compared tidal channels, planting, and a combined treatment to restore marsh vegetation.
Researchers proved planting was the cheapest restoration method.
options.whyWrong: Cost is not discussed in the first paragraph.

options.text: An old road was removed from Bell Marsh.
options.whyWrong: The road restricted water, but its removal is not stated.

options.text: Every plot received the same restoration treatment.
options.whyWrong: The plots were divided among three different treatments.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice best matches the passage: Researchers compared tidal channels, planting, and a combined treatment to restore marsh vegetation.
explanation.quickTip: Keep the answer within the passage’s actual scope.

questions.prompt: Which sentence best summarizes the second paragraph?

options.text: All three treatments failed after one season.
options.whyWrong: Each treatment showed some positive results.

options.text: The combined treatment required no extra labor.
Each treatment had strengths and limitations, while the combined plots had the highest average cover.
Ground elevation was the only cause of plant survival.
options.whyWrong: Elevation is discussed later and is not the only factor.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice best matches the passage: Each treatment had strengths and limitations, while the combined plots had the highest average cover.
explanation.quickTip: Keep the answer within the passage’s actual scope.

questions.prompt: Which detail should be omitted from a concise whole-passage summary?

options.text: The team compared three restoration approaches.
options.whyWrong: This is central to the passage.

options.text: The first treatment used narrow channels.
The combined plots led in first-year cover but required more labor.
options.whyWrong: This is a key result and tradeoff.

options.text: Researchers want longer-term evidence before expanding the project.
options.whyWrong: This is a central limitation and next step.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice best matches the passage: The first treatment used narrow channels.
explanation.quickTip: Keep the answer within the passage’s actual scope.

questions.prompt: Which summary best represents the passage as a whole?

options.text: Planting seedlings is the only effective way to restore Bell Marsh.
options.whyWrong: The passage compares three approaches and does not make this claim.

options.text: Bell Marsh restoration failed because the old road permanently stopped all tidal flow.
options.whyWrong: The restoration tests produced mixed but useful results.

options.text: The combined method permanently solved Bell Marsh’s problems after one season.
options.whyWrong: Researchers explicitly warn against a long-term conclusion from one season.

options.text: A marsh trial found different benefits and limits across three restoration methods, so researchers plan longer monitoring before choosing how to expand.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice best matches the passage: A marsh trial found different benefits and limits across three restoration methods, so researchers plan longer monitoring before choosing how to expand.
explanation.quickTip: Keep the answer within the passage’s actual scope.

questions.prompt: Which idea belongs in a strong summary because it limits how the first-year results should be interpreted?

options.text: One season cannot establish which treatment will work best over many years.
Workers opened narrow channels in one group.
Some plots were lower than others.
options.whyWrong: The more important summary point is that elevation affected water conditions.

options.text: The project is located at Bell Marsh.
options.whyWrong: The place name is not a key limiting idea.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice best matches the passage: One season cannot establish which treatment will work best over many years.
explanation.quickTip: Keep the answer within the passage’s actual scope.

questions.prompt: Which summary is too narrow for the entire passage?

options.text: Researchers compared restoration methods and found tradeoffs that require longer-term study.
options.whyWrong: This covers the experiment, findings, and limitation.

options.text: A one-season marsh study suggests combined restoration may be promising, but researchers need more evidence before expansion.
The combined plots had the highest average plant cover after one season.
Bell Marsh researchers tested water access and planting strategies while considering labor, elevation, and long-term reliability.

explanation.whyCorrect: This choice best matches the passage: The combined plots had the highest average plant cover after one season.
explanation.quickTip: Keep the answer within the passage’s actual scope.
